newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Kejian likely to post loss.
newsitem.headline: China Kejian likely to post loss.

text.p: Shenzhen-based medical appliance producer China Kejian Co Ltd is expected to report a loss for 1996 due to increasingly sharp competition from foreign manufacturers, a company official said.
It will be the second year the company has suffered a loss.
The official told the Hong Kong-based news letter China Securities Bulletin that the competition had forced Kejian to further lower prices last year.
The company reported a net loss of 11.61 million yuan for 1995 against a net profit of 15.18 million yuan in 1994. Its 1996 results have yet to be released.
A company spokesman attributed the 1995 loss to widespread delays in paying for goods by some of its major customers, mainly state-run hospitals.
In order to minimize the impact from the stagnant medical appliance business, Kejian started production of digital pagers and video compact disc players in 1995, the official said.
But the production volume was fairly small and generated little profit last year, he said.
